visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a digital game interface for character customization. A man in a black suit with a comical fake mustache stands against a bright blue cosmic background. Text options for 'Face', 'Body', and 'Clothing' appear at the top. The character physically shrinks and grows as settings are adjusted. (2) A man wearing glasses and a beige shirt is seen sitting on a brown sofa in a brightly lit living room, typing frantically on a laptop with an exaggerated expression of intense focus and excitement. (3) On the game screen, three status bars labeled Wealth, Appearance, and Confidence rapidly fill with yellow light until they reach the maximum level. A large, stylized golden 'MAX' text overlay appears over the character in the suit. (4) The character in the suit stands in a bar-like environment with vertical wooden walls, holding a glass of yellow cocktail. He approaches a person wearing a pink wig and a white dress. Suddenly, a person in a blue police uniform with a mask and a hat labeled 'POLICE' grabs his shoulder. (5) Two men are sitting on the floor in a living room, one wearing a black cap and the other in glasses, looking at a screen. Two bottles of Lucido 40+ grooming products (Body Wash and Shampoo) are shown in a clean, studio-lit close-up. (6) A montage shows a man with a mustache showering in a bathroom with marble-patterned walls. He applies white foam to his hair and torso, with close-up shots of the soapy texture and water spraying from the shower head. (7) Back in the bar scene, the character in the suit is now successfully chatting with the pink-haired person. The final shot shows the two men from earlier; one holds his nose in disgust while the other looks embarrassed near the product placement.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main actor playing multiple roles, 1 friend in cap, 1 person in pink wig, 1 police officer.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a young adult male with black hair and glasses, wearing a beige shirt or a black suit with a fake mustache depending on the scene.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a glowing blue digital void, a modern domestic living room with a brown couch, a bar with wooden wall paneling, and a bathroom with light grey tiles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins with a fast speech rate and bright pitch over an upbeat synthesized EDM track. Frequent digital beeps and clicking sound effects sync with character customization visuals. The vocal delivery is enthusiastic and loud. (2) A transition sound effect leads into a sequence where the narration becomes more conversational but remains fast-paced. Typing sounds on a plastic keyboard are layered under the main voice. The background music maintains a consistent, driving beat. (3) A loud digital 'ding' sound effect signifies a maxed-out status. The narration shifts into a comedic story-telling mode with varying pitch contours. A distinct whoosh effect accompanies scene changes. The BGM remains bright and percussive. (4) During the shower montage, the sound of rushing water and soap lathering is audible. The voice switches to a clear, professional promotional tone, explaining product benefits. The music swells slightly in volume but stays under the narration. (5) A humorous tonal shift occurs at the end, where a voice sounds nasal and muffled as if the speaker is holding their nose. A final melodic jingle plays over the brand mention.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Failure -> Expert Correction -> Product Solution -> Success
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video uses a comedic narrative based on a life simulation game to highlight the issue of 'middle-age odor' (熟男味). It demonstrates how even a 'maxed-out' character can fail socially due to hygiene, ultimately positioning Lucido 40+ products as the essential solution for mature men.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product showcase, shower demonstration, brand slogans, and a call to action for the MOMO e-commerce platform.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes social media-native editing styles, including game-UI parodies and exaggerated character acting to maintain high engagement while delivering a commercial message.
